# Release Notes: v1.0.14

> This file is the source of truth for the GitHub Release body.
> The release workflow (`.github/workflows/release-android.yml`)
> copies this file's contents as the Release body via `body_path`.

This release introduces comprehensive financial integrity, historical accounting precision, CSV export security, and isolated staging infrastructure.

## Android

- **Deleted tracker cleanup & phantom savings fix** — deleting a tracker now cleanly prunes its pricing snapshots from day logs instead of retaining phantom snapshots (#156)
- **Real-time financial mode subscription** — the app now subscribes to real-time mode changes and cleanly resets state on logout (#156)
- **Historical accounting accuracy** — zero-count days and missing snapshot days are handled with explicit distinction, preventing fallback pricing estimation errors on unclosed historical days (#156)
- **Monetary rounding precision** — enforced half-away-from-zero rounding consistency with floating-point tie-break stabilization across financial calculations (#156)
- **CSV export formula injection protection** — hardened CSV export escaping to neutralize leading formula characters (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`) and embedded newlines (#156)
- **Timezone clearing & clock injection** — timezones can now be cleared cleanly in settings, and injected clocks remain consistent during stale day reconciliation (#156)
- **Isolated Staging Environment support** — Android build variant configuration for dedicated staging environment (#157)

## Web (already live)

These shipped through Firebase Hosting and need no app update; they are listed here so this release records everything since v1.0.13.

- **Financial lock on day close** — wrapped day closure operations in concurrency locks to prevent race conditions during parallel sync or stale day reconciliation (#156)
- **Pruned deleted snapshots** — parity with Android for deleted tracker counts and historical log pruning (#156)
- **Export security & precision parity** — identical CSV and JSON export protections and monetary rounding stabilization (#156)

## Infrastructure & CI/CD

- **Dependency vulnerability audits** — automated `audit:prod` enforcement for functions and web packages in CI (#156)
- **Post-signature APK verification** — automated `apksigner` validation in Android release pipeline (#156)
- **Staging environment isolation** — dedicated staging project (`tabakpwa`) with strict fail-closed guards preventing cross-environment credential leaks (#157)
